{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Remove [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]] editing layer.
{{Feature|informative|[[delete3DENEntities]] seems to be more reliable.}}

|s1= [[remove3DENLayer]] layerID

|p1= layerID : [[Number]] - layer ID as returned by [[add3DENLayer]] command
|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the layer was removed successfully (i.e., correct layer ID was used)

|x1= <sqf>
private _myLayer = -1 add3DENLayer "Enemy Base";
remove3DENLayer _myLayer;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[add3DENLayer]] [[set3DENLayer]] [[get3DENLayerEntities]]
}}
